about: Tactics and Strategy say only what their boards show. Graded by gate 175 (TC-R246a..d, and TC-R262 for his q23 answer of 19 Nov 2026: the longer, friendlier wrong-try lines, the box that keeps its place, and smaller text on a short phone only) on a trial bundle at 375x761 with his insets and at 320x568: every legal wrong move of all 13 Tactics cards is played and its line is never the bare fixed line, is true where it names a mate or a piece hung, and is wholly inside its box; a tap that is no legal move says so; each chess claim in a Tactics idea, hint, explanation and wrong-try line, and in each of the 18 Strategy cards' look line and text, is checked against the position with the app's rules and this gate's own attack count; and the screen shows the row's words and board. Batch 14 (the job's remainder, tacWrongLine in gates/engine-extract.js): TC-R246f runs the shipped tacWrongLine in node over every legal wrong move and the no-legal tap of every card (a reply that mates, found by playing every reply, must be named first; every other line a true hangs/drops line or the card's line), and TC-R246g holds the line on screen to that function's output move by move. #553 (his Q68 pick, 23 Nov 2026, 'A more button'): TC-R262 now pins the line at the box's own size on every phone (the 11.5px floor is gone), TC-R298 holds the 'more' chip to appear exactly when the line does not fit the box at full size (measured by a hidden copy, not by the app's own cut), the line itself to cut at whole lines inside the box with no word under the chip, and the chip to open the whole line over the box and close it again; TC-R299 holds that no faded sliver shows while a line is up; graded at 375x667 too. NOT COVERED HERE: the engine questions (the stored moves are best, the open-file invasion works, the bishop pair is a small edge) are gate 129, TC-R205a..e, which runs Stockfish in node and has no screen situation; general advice with no position claim; the sideways and desktop layouts, which draw the same line in another box; his phone. Since #553 (his pick B on card 80, run-answers orchestrator-B14-Q7-2026-11-24) TC-R412 is graded too: at 320x568 the more chip's room is kept only under the last line shown.

breaks.name: fixed-line-back
breaks.why: the card's own line is dropped: a wrong move the board proves nothing about, and a tap that is no legal move, read 'Not the key move. Try again.' again (213 of the 238 legal wrong moves)

breaks.name: open-file-no-luft
breaks.why: Put rooks on open files goes back to the board without h3, where the invasion its text promises loses: Rc7 allows Rd1 mate and Rc8+ drops the rook

breaks.name: line-cut-on-a-short-phone
breaks.why: the wrong-try line is no longer scrolled to the top of its box, so at 320x568 its whole lines sit under the card's name and run past the box's foot (regenerated at #553 against the more-chip code)

breaks.name: short-line-back
breaks.why: the 13 card lines go back to the short ones he was shown before his q23 answer ('Not Nc3. One knight move checks the king and attacks the queen.'): the longer, friendlier sentence and the clue it carries are gone

breaks.name: wrong-line-not-extracted
breaks.why: tacWrongLine is dropped from the engine extractor's NAMES again (the state before batch 14): node cannot run the shipped function, so the 238 wrong moves are judged only where a screen run plays them

breaks.name: wrong-line-skips-the-board-reason
breaks.why: tacWrongLine stops asking wrongWhy, so a move that allows a mate (Discovered attack Kh1) or hangs a piece reads the card's sentence instead; every TC-R246a screen line stays green on this break (measured at kunal761), only TC-R246f sees it

breaks.name: screen-line-not-the-function
breaks.why: the Tactics page builds its own 'Not <move>. <line>' at the call site instead of calling tacWrongLine, so the board's reason never reaches the screen while the function is still right; every TC-R246a line stays green (measured at kunal761), only TC-R246g sees it

breaks.name: 11px-back
breaks.why: batch 13's shrink comes back: on a short phone a line too tall for the box steps down to 11.5px instead of keeping its size and showing the more chip

breaks.name: more-missing
breaks.why: the line is still cut at whole lines but the more chip is not drawn, so the rest of the line cannot be read and nothing says there is more

breaks.name: faded-sliver-back
breaks.why: the idea is drawn under the wrong-try line again and the box fades at its foot, so a faded part-line of the idea peeks under the line on a short phone

breaks.name: chip-room-on-every-line
breaks.why: his pick B undone (card 80): the more chip's 68px is kept clear on the right of every line of a cut wrong-try line again, so the lines above the last break narrower than the box and fewer words show before more
